description: Test script using Playwright for end-to-end testing of API call duplication prevention in booking system, covering individual, team, and organization team events at month boundaries.

methods.name: testDuplicateAPICalls
methods.description: Performs API call routing and counts calls to specific endpoints during page navigation to detect duplicate calls.

methods.name: getStableTestDate
methods.description: Generates a fixed date in the middle of a month to ensure consistent test behavior across runs.
